reel3-tips: Same two dumbbells? You can still get stronger.
Rule one: add reps before weight. Pick a range, like eight to twelve, and climb it.
Rule two: hit twelve on every set? Add a set.
Rule three: maxed out? Slow it down. Three seconds down, one second pause, one second up.
